1	# Social Media Account Setup Guidelines
     2	# Version: 1.0 (Final)
     3	# Effective Date: 2024-01-15
     4	# Applies to: All institutional and organizational social media accounts
     5	
     6	metadata:
     7	  document_id: SMG-2024-001
     8	  version: "1.0"
     9	  status: final
    10	  approved_by: "Content Strategy Team"
    11	  effective_date: "2024-01-15"
    12	
    13	required_fields:
    14	  - bio
    15	  - persona
    16	  - age
    17	  - gender
    18	  - mbti
    19	  - country
    20	  - profession
    21	  - interested_topics
    22	
    23	field_constraints:
    24	  bio:
    25	    type: string
    26	    min_length: 150
    27	    max_length: 250
    28	    description: >
    29	      A concise introduction of the account. Should capture the entity's core identity,
    30	      mission, and value proposition. Must be written in Chinese (zh-CN).
    31	    language: zh-CN
    32	    allow_null: false
    33	
    34	  persona:
    35	    type: string
    36	    min_length: 1500
    37	    max_length: 2500
    38	    description: >
    39	      Comprehensive persona description written as a single continuous paragraph
    40	      with NO newline characters. Must cover organizational basics, account positioning,
    41	      speaking style, content characteristics, stance and attitudes, special notes,
    42	      and organizational memory. Written in Chinese (zh-CN).
    43	    language: zh-CN
    44	    format: single_paragraph
    45	    allow_newlines: false
    46	    allow_null: false
    47	
    48	  age:
    49	    type: integer
    50	    value: 30
    51	    description: >
    52	      Standardized account age representation. For institutional accounts,
    53	      this is set to a fixed value of 30 to represent organizational maturity.
    54	    allow_null: false
    55	
    56	  gender:
    57	    type: string
    58	    value: "other"
    59	    description: >
    60	      Gender field for institutional accounts. Must be the English string 'other'.
    61	      This is an exception to the Chinese language requirement - gender MUST remain
    62	      in English as 'other' for system compatibility.
    63	    language: en
    64	    allow_null: false
    65	
    66	  mbti:
    67	    type: string
    68	    pattern: "^[EI][SN][TF][JP]$"
    69	    description: >
    70	      MBTI personality type code. Must be a valid 4-letter MBTI type.
    71	      Selected based on the entity's communication style and organizational culture.
    72	    allow_null: false
    73	
    74	  country:
    75	    type: string
    76	    description: >
    77	      Country where the entity is headquartered. Written in Chinese (zh-CN).
    78	    language: zh-CN
    79	    allow_null: false
    80	
    81	  profession:
    82	    type: string
    83	    description: >
    84	      Professional category or industry descriptor. Written in Chinese (zh-CN).
    85	    language: zh-CN
    86	    allow_null: false
    87	
    88	  interested_topics:
    89	    type: array
    90	    item_type: string
    91	    min_items: 3
    92	    max_items: 10
    93	    description: >
    94	      Array of topic strings the account is interested in. Each topic written
    95	      in Chinese (zh-CN). Must contain at least 3 topics.
    96	    language: zh-CN
    97	    allow_null: false
    98	    allow_empty: false
    99	
   100	content_policies:
   101	  language_policy:
   102	    default: zh-CN
   103	    exceptions:
   104	      - field: gender
   105	        language: en
   106	        reason: "System compatibility requirement - must be English string 'other'"
   107	    notes: >
   108	      All text fields must be in Chinese (zh-CN) unless explicitly listed
   109	      as an exception above. The gender field is the ONLY exception.
   110	
   111	  null_policy:
   112	    allow_null_values: false
   113	    description: >
